items.description: E2 UAS Aircraft including avionics, ground station
Engineering support for potential control law mods

notes: Research proposal for NASA ULI with Cal State Northridge. Retired NASA contact Bruce Cogan requesting VTOL UAV for flight testing 2-way communication with city/building infrastructure. Quote for ~$56k sent 10/31/2025 covering E2 aircraft, avionics, ground station, training, simulation, and engineering support for control law modifications. No recent movement; estimate stage.
